examples.en: I wrote my thoughts with the special ink pen.
Reading nourishes the mind with knowledge and science.
O John, take the Scripture with strength.

examples.ar: وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ أَبْصَارُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا.
examples.en: And the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved stare in horror.

translation: heart, core, reverse / also (قَلَبَ) he inverted

examples.en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of God do hearts find peace.

examples.ar: اتَّخَذَتِ الإِدَارَةُ قَرَارًا هَامًّا لِتَحْسِينِ العَمَلِ.
examples.en: The administration took an important decision to improve the work.

examples.ar: تَكْمُنُ قِيمَةُ العِلْمِ فِي العَمَلِ بِهِ لِصَالِحِ البَشَرِيَّةِ.
examples.en: The value of knowledge lies in practicing it for the benefit of humanity.
